scripts.build:cloudflare: vite build -c vite.cloudflare.config.ts && vite build -c vite.cloudflare-isolate.config.ts
scripts.serve: npm run build && npm run build:server && node --no-warnings src/server/serve.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.space.json && npm run -s build:cloudflare -- --logLevel warn && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.cloudflare.json
scripts.test:server: npm run build && npm run build:server && node --no-warnings tests/server/run.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:server && node tests/platform.test.mjs
scripts.prepare: npm run build && npm run build:server
